text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: (Yes—I have always...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(...I was always watching. Always watching 
her.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Trainer, let's have another fun 
workout today!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Muscles blow all your worries away! 
Muscle, hustle, hassle-free!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: (—I always watched. Her victories.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: *Gulp, gulp, phaaah!!*

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Man, nothing beats a sports drink after a 
nice, refreshing run!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(—I always looked up to you. And behind 
that admiration... I was always hiding my 
true feelings.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: (The truth is—the truth is—!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I always wanted to win. Against her.

Starting today, the Twinkle Series 
challenge alongside Mejiro Ryan begins.

Her raw talent and well-trained physique 
rank among the best, even within the 
prestigious Mejiro family. The real 
problem is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Trainer, please train my heart and mind!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I... was born into the prestigious Mejiro 
family, and huge things were always 
expected of my future...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I could never beat my childhood 
friend, Mejiro McQueen....”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen is incredible. The Mejiro of 
Mejiros, the lady of ladies!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Fast, strong, hardworking, elegant, 
well-groomed...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Even though we're both Mejiros, her 
resolve was on a whole different level. 
Every time I compared us, all I did was 
give up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I want to break free from that! I 
came to Tracen Academy to win, after all!”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I want to race in the Classics I've always 
dreamed of! I want to become a strong 
Umamusume who can stand alongside McQueen! 
That's why...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: —Ugh, put that way...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm so sorry, I'm so sorry... I've 
just been like this for years.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Even in the Mejiro family, they told me, 
'With such a blessed physique, you're 
undoubtedly Classic material,' but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
When it becomes an actual mock race 
format, I just can't deliver... I can't 
bring out the results of our training 
properly...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
“B-But I truly want to change that part of 
myself! I really, really mean it!!”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I believe that you can change me, Trainer— 
the me who wants to change. That's why...!

There was no lie in Mejiro Ryan's 
determination. And then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, if you're already in that state, I 
dread to think what lies ahead, Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: McQueen!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"It brings me great joy to see that you 
have finally made up your mind."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Still, it will not be easy, you know? 
Striving to become your ideal self, that 
is."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I know. I know, but... I don't want to run 
away anymore.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I want to become an Umamusume that even 
McQueen can respect!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: So... let's settle this!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: —A match. You did say it, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"To be able to state that with such 
conviction is admirable in itself. I shall 
gladly accept."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Well then, until we meet again. Ryan, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
At the proper time, in the proper place. I 
look forward to seeing you give your all 
in the Classics.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
choice_data_list: You really said it with conviction, Ryan.

You really said it with conviction, didn't 
you, Ryan?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wawawa, what a cheeky thing for me to 
say to McQueen~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Is it okay, I wonder? It'll be fine, 
right...? Yeah, I just have to work as 
hard as I said I would...!"

Her legs are trembling. She has a fine 
physique, but her heart has yet to catch 
up.

While I was thinking about how to 
strengthen them—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I was watching you, Ryan-chan. You were 
trembling quite a bit, weren't you~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah, Ines?

(This girl is Ines Fujin. She's Mejiro 
Ryan's roommate and a close friend from 
the same class.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Trying to act grown-up just makes me 
overthink things, so it's better to just 
keep an empty head.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Wanna do tandem training? I'll be your 
partner!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Training... Yeah, I feel like moving my 
body might help clear my head.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Trainer, do you have a moment?
choice_data_list: Yeah, why don't you check it out?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yes, thank you so much!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's run, Ines! We're gonna do 
our best for your debut~!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ah... Ryan-chan is fast! So fast~!

In the blink of an eye, she vanished from 
sight. When there's no pressure, she's 
truly fast.

A great physique, but lacking the heart to 
match— the glass ace, Mejiro Ryan...

I will teach her plenty of courage and 
raise her into a true ace.
